Controls

MouseAim; She Steers Toward It WRun Forward SBrake: Slide to a Stop SpaceJump: hold for full height, tap to hop Q EMolly: Strafe, a Quick Hop Left / Right (not in the Barrier) Left Mouse Right MouseSidestep: Hold to Walk Left / Right (not in the Barrier) 2Molly: Barrier on / off, an unhurtable red shell Q EComet: Star Throw Where the Camera Faces (hold to charge, up to 3 s) 2Comet: Hover On / Off SpaceComet, Hovering, Held in the Air: Fly A DDrift: at 30 Zips or more, swing 15° that way (1 s cooldown; not in the Barrier) Hold SStanding still: Runner's Pose. After 3 s, let go to launch at 50 Zips Hold SStanding still in the Barrier: Dodecadash. Let go to launch, +20 Zips per second held (max 120), 4 power a second WheelCamera In / Out (it also pulls back a little as you speed up) Caps LockFree Look: press to turn it on (the mouse turns only the camera) and again to turn it off (it swings back behind you). Turning it on also does Lock Heading: on a path, Molly turns once to face along it (once a second; too sharp a turn above 20 Zips trips her) EscPause F4Mouse look mode: locked, or locked with raw input. Press Esc, then Play again, after changing it
